start.speaker: Odile
start.text: You unmade an office and the office answered. That is the shape of every account in the book.

r2.speaker: Odile
r2.text: Four floors. The fourth is where the copies start disagreeing with each other. I would like to hear what you saw.

r3.speaker: Odile
r3.text: Through, and out, and the building still standing. Somebody will strike that from the record. Tell me first.

r4.speaker: Odile
r4.text: The cathedral. Four hundred orders of service printed for the Return of the Light and not one of them used. I have counted them. Twice.

r5.speaker: Odile
r5.text: Ten. Every relighting is an entry, and entries accumulate, and accumulation is what the Hierarch was counting on.

quiet.speaker: Odile
quiet.text: I read what is left. There is a great deal left and almost none of it agrees.
